scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind why we use databases.
Database: is an organised collection of related information. Record: is one complete entry.
Field: is a named piece of data in an entry. Table: arranges records in rows and fields in columns. Query: asks a database to find matching information.
Collect a few harmless facts about classroom materials, NOT personal details. Make a paper chart with the terms Database, Record and Field; explain what each means.
